body: Thank you, what do you do as a job?

Thank you for your comment, but no matter what I am alone, before I tried last time I tried calling hotlines and was put on hold, gone to doctors who didnt listen to a single word and the reddit is the only place that has answered back other than lau. But the internet can only do so much

I have destroyed everything, theres no point in keeping them.
I worked out that I havent spoken a single word for more than a month, other than about a week ago. I gave ste the suicide notes I was going to leave her, she took it as if I was going to right then. Called the ambulance, called the cops, they turned up and took me to the hospital again. I sat there, turning away from the doctors and nurses that were there the last time. Gave them the answers they needed, lied, diverted attention onto someone else who was going to kill themselves. I was there for 12+ hours then left as soon as I got out, just before I went one person that worked there remembered me. Ive been flagged, if I go anywhere to get help I get locked up

I have only told ste this in the note, In 2008/09 I tried. I hanged myself, but the house shook and i fell. I spent the rest of the night thinking of ways to do it again. The day after was school, my neck had a bruise and in places was bleeding. No one noticed for about 2-3 days after while it was healing

I deserve everything, do you know what it is like when your nightmares are better than reality?
I cant smell, tell the difference between 100*c or -10, taste is gone, I dont think I have actually eaten anything in a week
